intent: Implement HistoryEventPublisher (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Stream Processing & History. Outbound published-language stream port broadcasting TelemetrySampleBackfilled, TelemetryRevisionAppended and TelemetryWindowBuffered. Out-of-process boundary: subscribers are downstream systems declared in the strategy.

methods.semantics: Completes when the event is placed on the bounded downstream broadcast buffer; overflow posture is DROP_OLDEST so it never fails for slow subscribers.
Subscriber-facing hot stream for downstream analytics (PulseStream Engine); consumers are out-of-process, no consumer unit exists in this service.
